headings.usage: Use tight letter spacing (tracking-tight) for massive impact. Never use for body text.

body.usage: Clean, highly readable geometric sans for all standard text.

primary.description: High-energy Electric Blue, establishing a tech-startup feel.

accent.description: Mandatory WhatsApp green for communication buttons.

visual_enhancers.textures: Subtle digital grain overlay (opacity 2-3%) on the main background to break the sterility of solid white/blue.
visual_enhancers.borders: 1px solid border-blue-900/10 on cards and bento grids. Use 'Crystal Glass' style strictly over photos, otherwise flat and crisp.
visual_enhancers.shapes: Rectangular cards with minimal border radius (rounded-xl) for a 'tech' feel. Avoid excessively soft/bubbly radii.
visual_enhancers.photography: Spotlight treatment. Real product/impact photography placed in clean clipped frames or grid cells.

buttons.primary: bg-[#0033FF] text-white hover:bg-[#0029CC] px-8 py-4 rounded-full font-medium transition-all inline-flex items-center justify-center
buttons.whatsapp: bg-[#25D366] text-white hover:bg-[#1DA851] px-6 py-4 rounded-full font-medium transition-all flex items-center gap-2
buttons.email: bg-white text-[#0A0F24] border border-gray-200 hover:border-[#0033FF] px-6 py-4 rounded-full font-medium transition-all flex items-center gap-2
buttons.donation_chip: border border-blue-200 bg-white hover:border-[#0033FF] hover:bg-blue-50 text-[#0033FF] px-6 py-3 rounded-xl font-medium transition-colors

cards.bento: bg-white border border-gray-100 rounded-2xl p-8 hover:shadow-lg transition-shadow relative overflow-hidden

navigation.style: Sticky glassmorphism header (backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/80 border-b border-gray-200/50). Include Logo, main links, a top-right dropdown for 'Nous contacter' (Email/WhatsApp), and a language switcher FR/EN.

grids.bento_grid: Use CSS grid with varying col-spans. For 'Nos 3 Espaces Clés', use a 12-column grid where cards span 12, 6, or 4 columns based on breakpoint to create an asymmetric, dynamic feel.

layouts.spacing: Generous vertical rhythm. Use py-24 or py-32 between main sections.
layouts.manifesto: 3-pillar layout with staggered elements. Each pillar features a massive numbered background chapter (01, 02, 03) with text-8xl text-blue-600/5.

motion.scrolling: Implement smooth scrolling using @studio-freight/lenis wrapped at the app root level.
motion.hero_reveal: Kinetic line-by-line text reveal for the H1 using framer-motion (initial y: 100%, animate to y: 0 inside an overflow-hidden wrapper).
motion.marquee: Use react-fast-marquee for a slow editorial ribbon displaying key values/words across the screen.
motion.parallax: Subtle parallax on hero images or background elements (framer-motion useScroll).

accessibility.contrast: Ensure all text, especially white text on blue or blue on white, meets APCA/WCAG standards.
accessibility.testing: All interactive elements (buttons, links, form inputs) MUST include a 'data-testid' attribute (e.g., data-testid='whatsapp-contact-button').

image_urls.description: Man using laptop in modern tech context.
A man with a laptop, tech startup vibe.

3d_libraries.usage: Use framer-motion for smooth UI transitions and 2.5D parallax. Heavy 3D libraries (Three.js) are not required here to keep the startup feel lightning-fast, rely on crisp CSS and framer-motion instead.

instructions_to_main_agent: Build the application using React and Tailwind CSS in JavaScript (.js/.jsx files). DO NOT USE TypeScript.
Install and setup @studio-freight/lenis for smooth scrolling at the app root level.

Implement the 'Nos 3 Espaces Clés' section as a high-density bento grid. Under EVERY program block, you MUST place two side-by-side contact buttons: 'Discuter par Email' and 'Discuter par WhatsApp' (Green #25D366).
The Hero section must feature the exact French slogan 'Co-créer le futur : quand l'exil devient une force d'innovation durable.' with a line-by-line framer-motion reveal.
Include a 'Feuille de route — Première année' section as a vertical winding timeline showing Months 1-3, 4-6, and 7-12.
Create a dedicated 'Faire un don' component with amount selectors (10/25/50/100 EUR).
Ensure the 'Notre Esprit' section uses a 3-pillar layout with massive numbered chapters (01, 02, 03) styled gracefully in the background.
Add a language switcher (FR/EN) in the navigation.
Build the Contact page with a classic form + Email/WhatsApp direct buttons.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Do not use generic centered layouts or simplistic gradients. Create asymmetry.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels standard (p-8, p-12, p-24).
Avoid the 'AI slop' look: ensure sharp, distinctive components rather than default generic look.
Every interaction needs micro-animations (hover states, focus).
Do not use complete transparent backgrounds for headers or overlays where text becomes unreadable.
Always use modern pill-shaped or rounded-xl buttons.
Include `data-testid` on all interactables for automated testing.
Rely exclusively on the provided image_urls for media. NEVER use placeholder services like via.placeholder.com.
